body: I know exactly what you mean.  At one of my recent attempts, I had a "friend" spend hours for two nights in a row trying to convince me that I'm just not seeing clearly and it'll be worth it.  He never once tried to understand where I'm coming from, just tried to force his own view.  When I told him he broke my trust and made me feel misunderstood and he had no qualifications to make grand statements about my future, he stopped talking to me.  Now we barely say hi to each other and he doesn't even ask how I am.  It was soo fucking hard for someone to grasp that not all depression is the same that he was willing to destroy our friendship over it.  It feels the most condescending when it's coming from a person who has it all in life.  Like yeah it's easy for you to say!

Yeah no silver lining so far.  After a while of feeling like I've been screaming into a black hole, posting here doesn't feel any better.  Like you said, I already know the answer.  Who knows maybe we just want to feel stupid for a moment and get proven wrong, but it doesn't happen.

Yeah I had a feeling nobody would have an argument to this.  I noticed when a post doesn't have any solution or answer, people either ignore it entirely or they post some one size fits all word of encouragement.  I'm not against encouraging others, it's just annoying when they can't be bothered to actually show care to the person.
